normative_extracts.spec_section: WHATWG HTML: Images — srcset, sizes, and decoding
normative_extracts.quote: The decoding attribute hints to the user agent whether to decode the image synchronously or asynchronously off the main thread.
The loading attribute controls lazy loading of offscreen images, while fetchpriority hints relative network urgency for the LCP candidate.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Selects resolution-appropriate AVIF/WebP candidates via srcset/sizes, decodes bitmaps off the main thread, and reserves aspect-ratio boxes to prevent CLS.

production_failures.symptom: LCP image starts downloading 2 seconds late after JS hydration
production_failures.root_cause: Hero had loading="lazy" applied globally, deferring the LCP image until layout computed viewport intersection.
production_failures.mitigation: Never put loading="lazy" on above-the-fold LCP images; set loading="eager" and fetchpriority="high".

production_failures.symptom: Mobile devices download 2400px desktop hero JPEGs
production_failures.root_cause: omitted sizes attribute alongside srcset, causing the preload scanner to default sizes to 100vw or pick an oversized candidate.
production_failures.mitigation: Provide accurate media-conditioned sizes (e.g., (max-width: 768px) 100vw, 50vw) and intrinsic width/height attributes.
